correctness.rationale: The graph, 2304 coordinate actions, 40 classes, and exact recurrence are defined explicitly. The published Proposition 25 proves degree-three homology concentration and rank 63 for this graph. The reduced simplicial Lefschetz identity gives the orbit-independence polynomial at -1 as the degree-three trace. Independent enumeration of all 136063 independent faces confirms every class-representative trace. Direct evaluation of all 2304 actions agrees by class, and exact S4-wreath irreducible inner products yield eight constituents of total dimension 63. This proves the finite claim subject to the stated published theorem, not merely a numerical experiment.

value.rationale: For the smallest balanced case K2×K4×K4 beyond the cycle-product reduction K2×K3×Kn, the complete natural symmetry representation is a motivated unknown invariant. The new result upgrades the known 63-sphere count to a multiplicity-free decomposition into eight rational irreducibles and distinguishes a factor-preserving invariant line reversed by factor exchange. This precise structure, including the 36/27 central-layer parity split, is intrinsic, not implied by dimension, and useful for symmetry quotients and comparing equivariant models. The finite scope is explicit and not a random parameter slice.
